<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;6.2<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Delegation
of Duties</B>. Unless the Board of Directors determines otherwise, if a title is one commonly used for officers of a corporation incorporated
under the DGCL, the assignment of such title shall constitute the delegation to such person of the authorities and duties that are normally
associated with that office with respect to the Partnership generally and each Series. The Board of Directors may delegate to any Officer
any of the powers and authority of the Board of Directors to the extent permitted by applicable law, including the power to bind the
Partnership generally and the Series. Any delegation pursuant to this <U>Section&#8239;6.2</U> may be revoked at any time by the Board
of Directors.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;6.3<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Officers
as Agents</B>. The Officers, to the extent of their powers set forth under applicable law or this Agreement or otherwise vested in them
by action of the Board of Directors not inconsistent with applicable law or this Agreement, are agents of the Partnership generally and
each Series&#8239;for the purpose of the business of the Partnership generally and each Series&#8239;and the actions of the Officers taken
in accordance with such powers shall bind the Partnership generally and the applicable Series, as applicable.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>ARTICLE&#8239;VII<BR>
SHARES; CAPITAL CONTRIBUTIONS</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;7.1<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>General
and Limited Partners</B>. Upon its execution of a counterpart signature page&#8239;to this Agreement, Monroe Capital Asset-Backed Finance
Company GP, LLC hereby continues as the general partner of the Partnership generally and the general partner of the Partnership associated
with each of Series&#8239;I and Series&#8239;II.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;7.2<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Series</B>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(a)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Each
of Series&#8239;I and Series&#8239;II has previously been formed, and upon execution of this Agreement hereby continues without dissolution,
as a registered series of partnership interests in the Partnership within the meaning of Section&#8239;17-221 of the Act. The terms of
each Series&#8239;shall be as set forth in this Agreement and, if the Board of Directors so determines, in a separate Series&#8239;Agreement
for each Series&#8239;in the form attached hereto as <U>Exhibit&#8239;I</U>, but with any changes therein that the Board of Directors may
determine in its sole discretion and without the consent of any Limited Partner or any other Person (other than any Subscription Line
Lender solely to the extent required by the terms of the related Credit Facility). No Series&#8239;shall be required to have a separate
Series&#8239;Agreement. Except as expressly provided otherwise in this Agreement, (i)&#8239;the terms and provisions of a Series&#8239;Agreement
may have the effect of altering, supplementing and amending the terms and provisions hereof with respect to the related Series, and (ii)&#8239;to
the extent that any of the terms or provisions of a Series&#8239;Agreement conflict with any of the terms or provisions of this Agreement
as applied to the relevant Series, the terms or provisions of such Series&#8239;Agreement shall control with respect to such Series.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="text-align: center; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->27<!-- Field: /Sequence --></FONT></P></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(b)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Unless
otherwise expressly set forth herein, the debts, liabilities, obligations and expenses incurred, contracted for or otherwise existing
with respect to a particular Series&#8239;shall be enforceable against the assets of such Series&#8239;(or the general partner associated
with such Series) only, and not against the assets of the Partnership generally or any other Series&#8239;(or any general partner not
associated with such Series), and none of the debts, liabilities, obligations and expenses incurred, contracted for or otherwise existing
with respect to the Partnership generally or any other Series&#8239;shall be enforceable against the assets of such Series&#8239;(or any
general partner associated with such Series&#8239;who is not also general partner of the Partnership generally or the general partner
associated with such other Series, as the case may be). The records maintained for each Series&#8239;shall account for the assets associated
with such Series&#8239;separately from the other assets of the Partnership, or any other Series, and assets associated with a Series&#8239;may
be held, directly or indirectly, including in the name of such Series, in the name of the Partnership, through a nominee or otherwise.
Records maintained for a Series&#8239;that reasonably identify its assets, including by specific listing, category, type, quantity, computational
or allocational formula or procedure (including a percentage or share of any asset or assets) or by any other method where the identity
of such assets is objectively determinable, will be deemed to account for the assets associated with such Series&#8239;separately from
the other assets of the Partnership or any other Series. The Board of Directors and the Partnership shall not commingle the assets of
one Series&#8239;with the assets of any other Series&#8239;or the assets, if any, of the Partnership, generally. Notwithstanding the foregoing,
a Series&#8239;may agree to be liable, including jointly and severally liable, for the obligations of one or more other Series&#8239;and/or
of the Partnership generally, and the Partnership may agree to be liable, including jointly and severally liable, for the obligations
of one or more Series. The Board of Directors may allocate assets, debts, liabilities, expenses or other obligations of the Partnership
generally among the Series&#8239;in such percentages and proportions as the Board of Directors may determine.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(c)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Board of Directors may cause the Partnership generally and any Series&#8239;to allocate any property to any Series. A Person may be admitted
as a Limited Partner associated with such Series&#8239;in accordance with <U>Section&#8239;7.8</U> or <U>Section&#8239;10.4</U>, as applicable.
A Person may be admitted as a Limited Partner associated with one or more than one Series.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(d)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Certificate shall contain a notice of the limitation of liabilities of the Series&#8239;in conformity with Section&#8239;17-218 of the
Act and Section&#8239;17-221 of the Act.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(e)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Each
provision of this Agreement and each reference herein to the &ldquo;Partnership&rdquo; may, except as otherwise expressly provided, be
interpreted to mean &ldquo;the Partnership (including each Series&#8239;thereof)&rdquo; or &ldquo;the Partnership (including any Series&#8239;thereof)&rdquo;
where the context permits or requires such interpretation, each reference to the &ldquo;Partnership&rdquo; may be interpreted on a Series-by-Series&#8239;basis
where context permits or requires such interpretation, and each reference to a &ldquo;Series&rdquo; may be interpreted as a reference
to the &ldquo;Partnership generally&rdquo; where the context permits or requires such interpretation, in each case, as determined by
the Board in its good faith discretion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;7.3<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Shares</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(a)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
partnership interests in each Series&#8239;shall be represented by the &ldquo;<B>Share</B>&rdquo; or &ldquo;<B>Shares</B>&rdquo; held
by the Limited Partners associated with such Series. For the avoidance of doubt, Shares shall constitute economic interests in a Series&#8239;and
shall not confer on any holder thereof any partnership interest or any other interest in the Partnership generally or in any other Series,
including as a Limited Partner of the Partnership generally or as a Limited Partner associated with such other Series, and the holder
thereof shall not be entitled to any rights of a Limited Partner associated with the Series&#8239;of which it holds Shares, unless such
holder is admitted as a Limited Partner associated with such Series&#8239;in accordance with this Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(b)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Initially,
Series&#8239;I does not intend to offer any Shares to investors, however, nothing in this Agreement shall prevent Series&#8239;I from offering
Shares to investors at any time subject to the approval of the General Partner, in its sole discretion. Shares of Series&#8239;I shall
be divided in such classes and be subject to such sales loads, servicing fees, distribution fees, dealer manager fees, commissions, other
fees, aggregate commitment capacities and minimum investment requirements described below, as may be determined by the Board of Directors
from time to time in its sole discretion and set forth in the PPM. The Shares of Series&#8239;II shall initially be divided into six Classes
of Investor Shares, one Class&#8239;of E Shares, one Class&#8239;of E-W Shares, one Class&#8239;of WF Shares and one Class&#8239;of MF Shares.
Notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement, including <U>Article&#8239;XVII</U>, Classes of Investor Shares shall be subject
to such sales loads, servicing fees, distribution fees, dealer manager fees, commissions, other fees, aggregate commitment capacities
and minimum investment requirements described below, as may be determined by the Board of Directors from time to time in its sole discretion
and set forth in the PPM.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(c)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Investor
Shares will be offered monthly on a continuous basis at NAV per Share. Initially, there shall be six types of Investor Shares in Series&#8239;II:
(i)&#8239;Standard Fee Class-S Shares (&ldquo;<B>Standard Fee Class-S Shares</B>&rdquo;), (ii)&#8239;Standard Fee Class-I Shares (&ldquo;<B>Standard
Fee Class-I Shares</B>&rdquo;), (iii)&#8239;Founder Share Class&#8239;II-S Shares (&ldquo;<B>Founder Share Class&#8239;II-S Shares</B>&rdquo;),
(iv)&#8239;Founder Share Class&#8239;II-I Shares (&ldquo;<B>Founder Share Class&#8239;II-I Shares</B>&rdquo;), (v)&#8239;Founder Share Class&#8239;III-S
Shares (&ldquo;<B>Founder Share Class&#8239;III-S Shares</B>&rdquo;), (vi)&#8239;Founder Share Class&#8239;III-I Shares (&ldquo;<B>Founder
Share Class&#8239;III-I Shares</B>&rdquo; and Founder Share Class&#8239;II-S Shares, Founder Share Class&#8239;II-I Shares and Founder Share
Class&#8239;III-S Shares also referred to as &ldquo;<B>Founder Shares</B>&rdquo; and, collectively with Standard Fee Class-S Shares and
Standard Fee Class-I Shares, the &ldquo;<B>Series&#8239;II Investor Shares</B>&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(d)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Notwithstanding
any other provision of this Agreement, including <U>Article&#8239;XVII</U>, Class&#8239;E Shares (&ldquo;<B>E Shares</B>&rdquo;), Class&#8239;E-W
Shares (&ldquo;<B>E-W Shares</B>&rdquo;), Class&#8239;WF Shares (&ldquo;<B>WF Shares</B>&rdquo;) and Class&#8239;MF Shares (&ldquo;<B>MF
Shares</B>&rdquo;), shall be subject to such sales loads, servicing fees, distribution fees, dealer manager fees, commissions, other
fees, and minimum investment requirements described below, as may be determined by the Board of Directors from time to time in its sole
discretion and set forth in the PPM. E Shares, E-W Shares, WF Shares and MF Shares are not Investor Shares, and (a)&#8239;E Shares will
be held only by (i)&#8239;Monroe, its Affiliates, its officers and employees, (ii)&#8239;the directors, officers and employees (if any)
of the Partnership, and (iii)&#8239;certain other investors in the Operating Manager&rsquo;s discretion, and are not being offered to
other investors, (b)&#8239;E-W Shares will be held only by certain investors in the Operating Manager&rsquo;s discretion, and are not
being offered to other investors, (c)&#8239;WF Shares will be held only by certain investors in the Operating Manager&rsquo;s discretion,
and are not being offered to other investors, and (d)&#8239;MF Shares will be held only by certain investors in the Operating Manager&rsquo;s
discretion, and are not being offered to other investors.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;7.4<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Establishment
of New Classes; Authorized Shares.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(a)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<B></B>In addition to the Series&#8239;II Investor Shares, E Shares, E-W Shares, WF Shares and MF
Shares, the Board of Directors may, without the consent of any other Person, cause each Series&#8239;to (i)&#8239;create additional
Classes of Shares having such terms, rights, designations, preferences, powers and duties (which rights or powers may be senior to
existing Classes of Shares), as the Board of Directors shall determine, including, without limitation: (A)&#8239;the right of any
such Class&#8239;of Shares to share in Series&#8239;distributions; (B)&#8239;the allocation to any such Class&#8239;of Shares of
items of Series&#8239;income, gains, losses, deductions and credits; (C)&#8239;the rights of any such Class&#8239;of Shares upon
dissolution of the Partnership or the applicable Series; and (D)&#8239;the right of any such Class&#8239;of Shares to vote on
matters relating to the Partnership, the Series&#8239;and this Agreement and (ii)&#8239;issue Shares of any Class, for such
consideration, if any, as the Board of Directors may deem appropriate. The Limited Partners understand and agree that rights
afforded to any additional Class&#8239;of Shares (including, without limitation, rights to Partnership and
Series&#8239;distributions) may be senior to and result in a reduction and/or dilution in the rights of then outstanding Shares. In
connection with the creation of any additional Class&#8239;of Shares, the Board of Directors shall, without the consent of any other
Person, approve a Class&#8239;designation (a &ldquo;<B>Class&#8239;Designation</B>&rdquo;) setting forth the terms of such
Class&#8239;of Shares. Any such Class&#8239;Designation shall be attached as an annex to this Agreement. For all purposes of the
Act, this Agreement, together with each Series&#8239;Agreement (if any) and Class&#8239;Designation constitutes the
&ldquo;partnership agreement&rdquo; of the Partnership within the meaning of the Act.

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(b)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Partnership or the applicable Series&#8239;is authorized to issue an unlimited number of Shares of any Class&#8239;of any Series. The Board
of Directors may cause the Partnership or the applicable Series&#8239;to issue any number of Shares of any Class&#8239;of any Series&#8239;without
the consent of any Person. Subject to the terms of any Class&#8239;Designation, the Limited Partners holding each Class&#8239;of Shares
will have the same voting rights.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(c)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>As
set forth in the Operating Agreement, the Management Fee and the Performance Fee may be paid, at the Operating Manager&rsquo;s election,
in cash or E Shares. To the extent that the Operating Manager elects to receive any portion of the Management Fee or the Performance
Fee in E Shares, the Partnership may redeem such E Shares from the Operating Manager pursuant to the Share Redemption Program, and the
Operating Manager may elect to submit those shares for repurchase pursuant to the Share Redemption Program. E Shares of the Partnership
obtained by the Operating Manager will be subject to the repurchase limits of the Share Redemption Program, but will not be subject to
the Early Redemption Deduction.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;7.5<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Capital
Contribution by the General Partner</B>. Subject to applicable law and except as may otherwise be agreed by the Partnership generally
and/or applicable Series&#8239;and the General Partner, the General Partner shall have no obligation to make any capital contributions
to the Partnership generally or to either Series.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 35; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="text-align: center; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->30<!-- Field: /Sequence --></FONT></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&#8239;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;7.6<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Additional
Capital Contributions</B>. Subject to applicable law and except as otherwise provided in this Agreement or any Class&#8239;Designation
or as agreed by the Partnership, the applicable Series&#8239;and such Limited Partner, no Limited Partner shall be required to make any
Capital Contribution in addition to the purchase price paid for such Limited Partner&rsquo;s Shares.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;7.7<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Offering
of Shares</B>. Except as otherwise provided in this Agreement, the Board of Directors shall have sole and complete discretion in determining
the terms and conditions of the offer and sale of Shares and are hereby authorized and directed to do all things which the Board of Directors
deems to be necessary, convenient, appropriate and advisable in connection therewith, including the execution or performance of agreements
with selling agents and others concerning the marketing of the Shares, all on such basis and upon such terms as the Board of Directors
shall determine.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;7.8<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Admission
of Limited Partners; Subscriptions for Shares</B>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(a)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Other
than with respect to Substitute Limited Partners as provided in <U>Section&#8239;10.4</U>, no Person may be admitted as a Limited Partner,
either of the Partnership generally or associated with a particular Series, without the prior written consent of the Partnership. Subject
to obtaining such prior written consent, such Person shall be admitted as a Limited Partner either of the Partnership generally or associated
with a particular Series, as applicable, upon its execution of an instrument signifying its agreement to be bound by the terms and conditions
of this Agreement, the Series&#8239;Agreement of the applicable Series&#8239;(if any) and any applicable Class&#8239;Designation, which
instrument may be a counterpart signature page&#8239;to this Agreement or a Subscription Agreement, and such Person being listed as Limited
Partner in the Partnership&rsquo;s books and records.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(b)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Subscriptions
for Shares will be accepted or rejected by the Partnership, the Officers or the Board of Directors and, if rejected, all funds (or the
funds associated with the rejected portion of any partially-rejected subscription) shall be returned to such subscribers. The Partnership,
the Officers or the Board of Directors may refuse to accept subscriptions for Shares and contributions tendered therewith for any reason
whatsoever, or for no reason.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;7.9<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Redemption
of Shares</B>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(a)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>From
time to time, Limited Partners may request that the Partnership redeem their Shares, whether through their financial intermediary or
directly with the Partnership&rsquo;s transfer agent pursuant to the Partnership&rsquo;s share redemption program (the &ldquo;<B>Share
Redemption Program</B>&rdquo;) expected to commence with the fourth full quarter after the initial raising of third-party capital, and
as may be subsequently amended, modified, revised or restated by the Board of Directors in accordance with <U>Section&#8239;7.9(b)</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(b)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Board of Directors may, without the consent of any Person, amend, modify, revise or restate the Share Redemption Program if in its reasonable
judgment it deems such action to be in the Partnership&rsquo;s best interest and the best interest of the Limited Partners, including,
but not limited to, for tax, regulatory or other structuring reasons.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 36; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="text-align: center; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->31<!-- Field: /Sequence --></FONT></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&#8239;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(i)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Material
modifications to the Share Redemption Program, including any amendment to the five percent (5%) quarterly limitation on redemptions described
herein will be subject to the approval of the Independent Directors and promptly disclosed to Limited Partners in a supplement to the
PPM or special or periodic report filed by the Partnership. Material modifications will also be disclosed on the Partnership&rsquo;s
website.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(ii)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>In
addition, the Board of Directors may determine to suspend the Share Redemption Program if in its reasonable judgment it deems such action
to be in the Partnership&rsquo;s best interest and the best interest of Limited Partners, including, but not limited to, for tax, regulatory
or other structuring reasons. Any suspension of the Share Redemption Program will be promptly disclosed to Limited Partners in a supplement
to the PPM or special or periodic report filed by the Partnership.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(iii)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Once
the Share Redemption Program is suspended, the Board of Directors is required to consider the recommencement of the Share Redemption
Program at least quarterly. Continued suspension of this Share Redemption Program would only be permitted if the Board determines that
the continued suspension is in the best interest of the Partnership. The Board of Directors must affirmatively authorize the recommencement
of the Share Redemption Program before Limited Partner requests will be considered again. The Board of Directors cannot terminate the
Share Redemption Program absent a liquidity event which results in Limited Partners receiving cash or securities listed on a national
securities exchange, or results in the Shares being quoted on the over the counter market or otherwise becoming traded on a secondary
market or where otherwise required by law.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(c)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Pursuant
to the Share Redemption Program, the Partnership will redeem Shares using a purchase price (the &ldquo;<B>Transaction Price</B>&rdquo;)
equal to the NAV per Share as of the last calendar day of the applicable quarter, subject to the Early Redemption Deduction described
below (each, a &ldquo;<B>Share Redemption</B>&rdquo;). Because of differential fees and other factors, NAV between Share classes will
differ, but all NAV calculations are expected to be based on the joint underlying economic interests in the assets underlying its Asset-Backed
Finance Assets.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(d)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>For
each calendar quarter, a Limited Partner may request to redeem its Shares pursuant to the Share Redemption Program beginning on the opening
of business on the first Business Day of the second month of the applicable quarter, and no later than such deadline, as disclosed on
the Partnership&rsquo;s website the &ldquo;<B>Redemption Deadline</B>&rdquo;, which is generally expected to be 4:00 p.m.&#8239;(Eastern
time) on the 10th Business Day following the publication of NAV for the immediately preceding quarter and such submission period, the
&ldquo;<B>Redemption Window</B>&rdquo;. If a redemption request is received after 4:00 p.m.&#8239;(Eastern Time) on the Redemption Deadline
of the applicable calendar quarter, the redemption request will not be executed and, if a Limited Partner still wishes to have its Shares
redeemed, must be resubmitted after the start of the next quarter. Limited Partners may also withdraw their redemption requests by the
same deadline.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

                                            request by notifying the transfer agent, directly or through the Limited Partner&rsquo;s
                                            financial intermediary, on the Partnership&rsquo;s toll-free, automated telephone line. Information
                                            regarding withdrawing redemption requests will be posted on the Partnership&rsquo;s website.
                                            Redemption requests must be cancelled before 4:00 p.m.&#8239;(Eastern Time) on the Redemption
                                            Deadline of the applicable calendar quarter.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 38; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="text-align: center; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->33<!-- Field: /Sequence --></FONT></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&#8239;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">(v)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">For the avoidance of doubt, a redeeming
                                            Limited Partner will not be eligible to receive distributions declared on or after the redemption
                                            date specified in the redemption offer. Additionally, all Shares timely submitted for redemption
                                            and not withdrawn as of the Redemption Deadline, shall be excluded as of the redemption date
                                            specified in the redemption offer from the Partnership&rsquo;s NAV and such redeemed Shares
                                            will not bear fees or expenses, including but not limited to Management Fees, Performance
                                            Fees and distribution and servicing fees.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">(vi)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Requests for redemption are subject to
                                            an early redemption deduction (&ldquo;<B>Early Redemption Deduction</B>&rdquo;) of 5.00%
                                            of the NAV of the Shares redeemed from a Limited Partner if Shares are redeemed with redemption
                                            dates, as specified in the relevant redemption offers, within 12 months of the original issue
                                            date of such Shares; provided that the Partnership may, from time to time, waive the Early
                                            Redemption Deduction in the case of redemptions resulting from death, qualifying disability
                                            or divorce. Shares received through the DRIP will not be subject to an Early Redemption Deduction.
                                            The Partnership may also not apply the Early Redemption Deduction on redemptions of Shares
                                            submitted by (i)&#8239;certain feeder vehicles primarily created to hold such Shares and that
                                            in turn offer interests in such feeder vehicles to non-U.S. persons and (ii)&#8239;discretionary
                                            model portfolio management programs (and similar arrangements) as approved by the Partnership.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(f)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>A
Series&#8239;may redeem fewer Shares than have been requested in any particular quarter to be redeemed under the Share Redemption Program,
or none at all, at the sole discretion of the Board. In addition, the aggregate NAV of total redemptions of Shares each quarter will
be limited to no more than 5.00% of the Partnership&rsquo;s aggregate NAV as of the end of the prior quarter (measured collectively across
both Series&#8239;as of the close of the previous calendar quarter), unless otherwise authorized by the Board of Directors. Shareholders
who are exchanging a class of Shares for an equivalent aggregate NAV of another class of Shares will not be subject to, and will not
be treated as, redemptions for the calculation of the 5.00% quarterly calculation on redemptions and will not be subject to the Early
Redemption Deduction.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(g)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>In
the event that the Partnership determines to redeem some but not all of the Shares submitted for redemption during any quarter, Shares
submitted for redemption during such quarter will be redeemed on a pro rata basis after the Partnership has redeemed all Shares for which
redemption has been requested due to death, qualifying disability, divorce, dissolution, bankruptcy, insolvency or adjudicated incompetence
of the Limited Partner. All unsatisfied redemption requests must be resubmitted after the start of the next quarter, or upon the recommencement
of the Share Redemption Program, as applicable. The Transaction Price for each quarter will be available on the Partnership&rsquo;s website.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 39; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="text-align: center; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->34<!-- Field: /Sequence --></FONT></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&#8239;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(h)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Each
Series&#8239;will not redeem Shares if (1)&#8239;such purchases would impair the Partnership&rsquo;s status as a holding company; (2)&#8239;the
Series&#8239;would not be able to sell the Partnership assets in a manner that is orderly and consistent with the Partnership&rsquo;s
objectives in order to purchase Shares under the Share Redemption Program; or (3)&#8239;there is, in the Board of Directors&rsquo; judgment
any (a)&#8239;legal action or proceeding instituted or threatened challenging the Share Redemption Program or otherwise materially and
adversely affecting the Partnership, (b)&#8239;declaration of a banking moratorium by federal or state authorities or any suspension of
payment by banks in the United States or New York State, which is material to the Partnership, (c)&#8239;limitation imposed by federal
or state authorities on the extension of credit by lending institutions, (d)&#8239;commencement or escalation of war, armed hostilities,
acts of terrorism, natural disasters, public health crises or other international or national calamity directly or indirectly involving
the United States that in the sole determination of the Board of Directors is material to the Partnership, (e)&#8239;a material decrease
in the estimated NAV from the estimated NAV as of the commencement of the Share redemption offer or (f)&#8239;other events or conditions
that would have a material adverse effect on the Partnership or its Limited Partners if Shares were redeemed.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(i)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>All
Shares redeemed pursuant to the Share Redemption Program will be retired and thereafter will be authorized and unissued shares.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(j)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Partnership will assume or cause to be assumed all fees and expenses related to a redemption of Shares. A Limited Partner that has less
than all of its Shares redeemed must maintain a minimum account balance after the redemption is effected, the amount of which will be
established by the Partnership from time to time and is currently $500. If a Limited Partner requests the redemption of a number of Shares
that would cause the aggregate NAV of the Limited Partner&rsquo;s holdings to fall below the required minimum, a Series&#8239;reserves
the right to reduce the amount to be redeemed from the Limited Partner so that the required minimum balance is maintained. In the alternative,
the Partnership may also redeem all of such Limited Partner&rsquo;s Shares. The Partnership or the Operating Manager may waive the minimum
account balance from time to time.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>ARTICLE&#8239;VIII<BR>
CAPITAL CONTRIBUTIONS; CAPITAL ACCOUNTS</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;8.1<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Series&#8239;Capital</B>.
No Limited Partner shall be paid interest on any Capital Contribution or on such Limited Partner&rsquo;s Capital Account (if any), and
no Limited Partner shall have any right (i)&#8239;to demand the return of such Limited Partner&rsquo;s Capital Contribution or any other
distribution from the Partnership or any Series&#8239;(whether upon withdrawal or otherwise), except upon dissolution of the Partnership
or a Series&#8239;pursuant to <U>Section&#8239;18.2</U> hereof or pursuant to the Share Redemption Program, (ii)&#8239;to cause a partition
of the Partnership&rsquo;s or a Series&rsquo; assets, or (iii)&#8239;to own or use any particular or individual assets of the Partnership
or a Series.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;8.2<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Establishment
and Determination of Capital Accounts</B>. A capital account (&ldquo;<B>Capital Account</B>&rdquo;) shall be established for each Series&#8239;II
Limited Partner. The Capital Account of each Series&#8239;II Limited Partner shall consist of his, her or its initial Capital Contribution
and shall be (i)&#8239;increased by (a)&#8239;any additional Capital Contributions made by such Series&#8239;II Limited Partner pursuant
to the terms of this Agreement or any Class&#8239;Designation, (b)&#8239;the amount of any Partnership or Series&#8239;liabilities that
are assumed by such Series&#8239;II Limited Partner, and (c)&#8239;such Series&#8239;II Limited Partner&rsquo;s share of Series&#8239;II
Profits allocated to such Limited Partner pursuant to <U>Section&#8239;9.2</U>, (ii)&#8239;decreased by (a)&#8239;such Series&#8239;II Limited
Partner&rsquo;s share of Series&#8239;II Losses allocated to such Series&#8239;II Limited Partner pursuant to <U>Section&#8239;9.2</U> and
(b)&#8239;any distributions to such Series&#8239;II Limited Partner (net of liabilities assumed by such Series&#8239;II Limited Partner
and liabilities to which such property is subject) distributed to such Series&#8239;II Limited Partner and (iii)&#8239;adjusted as otherwise
required by the Code and the regulations thereunder, including the rules&#8239;of Treasury Regulation Section&#8239;1.704-1(b)(2)(iv).
Any references in this Agreement to the Capital Account of a Series&#8239;II Limited Partner shall be deemed to refer to such Capital
Account as the same may be increased or decreased from time to time as set forth above.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 40; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="text-align: center; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->35<!-- Field: /Sequence --></FONT></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&#8239;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;8.3<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Computation
of Amounts</B>. For purposes of computing the amount of any item of income, gain, loss, deduction or expense to be reflected in Capital
Accounts, the determination, recognition and classification of each such item shall be the same as its determination, recognition and
classification for U.S. federal income tax purposes; provided that:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(i)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>any
income that is exempt from U.S. federal income tax shall be added to such taxable income or losses;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(ii)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>any
expenditures of Series&#8239;II (or of the Partnership allocated to Series&#8239;II) described in Section&#8239;705(a)(2)(B)&#8239;of the
Code or treated as Code Section&#8239;705(a)(2)(B)&#8239;expenditures pursuant to Treasury Regulation Section&#8239;1.704-1(b)(2)(iv)(i),
shall be subtracted from such taxable income or losses;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(iii)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>if
the Book Value of any Series&#8239;II property is adjusted pursuant to Treasury Regulation Section&#8239;1.704-1(b)(2)(iv)(e)&#8239;(in
connection with a distribution of such property) or (f)&#8239;(in connection with a revaluation of Capital Accounts), then the amount
of such adjustment shall be taken into account as gain or loss from the disposition of such property;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(iv)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>if
property that is reflected on the books of Series&#8239;II has a Book Value that differs from the adjusted tax basis of such property,
then depreciation, amortization and gain or loss with respect to such property shall be determined by reference to such Book Value; and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(v)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>the
computation of all items of income, gain, loss, deduction and expense shall be made without regard to any election pursuant to Section&#8239;754
of the Code that may be made by Series&#8239;II, unless the adjustment to basis of Series&#8239;II property pursuant to such election is
reflected in Capital Accounts pursuant to Treasury Regulation Section&#8239;1.704-1(b)(2)(iv)(m).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;8.4<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Negative
Capital Accounts</B>. No Series&#8239;II Limited Partner shall be required to pay to the Partnership generally, a Series&#8239;or any other
Limited Partner any deficit or negative balance which may exist from time to time in such Series&#8239;II Limited Partner&rsquo;s Capital
Account.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;8.5<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Adjustments
to Book Value</B>. Series&#8239;II shall adjust the Book Value of its assets to fair market value in accordance with Treasury Regulation
Section&#8239;1.704-l(b)(2)(iv)(f)&#8239;as of the following times: (a)&#8239;at the Board of Directors&rsquo; discretion, in connection
with the issuance of Shares in Series&#8239;II and the computation of NAV thereon; (b)&#8239;at the Board of Directors&rsquo; discretion,
in connection with the distribution by Series&#8239;II to a Series&#8239;II Limited Partner of more than a <I>de minimis</I> amount of
Series&#8239;II assets, including cash, if as a result of such distribution, such Series&#8239;II Limited Partner&rsquo;s interest in Series&#8239;II
is reduced (including a redemption of Shares in Series&#8239;II); and (c)&#8239;the liquidation of Series&#8239;II within the meaning of
Treasury Regulation Section&#8239;1.704-1 (b)(2)(ii)(g). Any such increase or decrease in Book Value of an asset made pursuant to <U>Section&#8239;8.5</U>
shall, as a matter of administrative convenience, occur on a quarterly basis to take into consideration the contributions by and distributions
to Series&#8239;II Limited Partners over the course of a given quarter. Furthermore, any such increase or decrease in Book Value of an
asset shall be allocated as a Series&#8239;II Profit or Series&#8239;II Loss to the Capital Accounts of the Series&#8239;II Limited Partners
under <U>Section&#8239;9.2</U> (determined immediately prior to the issuance of the new Shares in Series&#8239;II or the distribution of
assets in an ownership reduction transaction).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 41; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="text-align: center; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->36<!-- Field: /Sequence --></FONT></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&#8239;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;8.6<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Compliance
With Section&#8239;1.704-1(b</B>). The provisions of this Agreement relating to the maintenance of Capital Accounts are intended to comply
with Section&#8239;1.704-1(b)&#8239;of the Treasury Regulations, and shall be interpreted and applied in a manner consistent with such
Treasury Regulations. If the Board of Directors determines that it is prudent to modify the manner in which the Capital Accounts, or
any debits or credits thereto (including debits or credits relating to liabilities which are secured by contributed or distributed property
or which are assumed by Series&#8239;II or any Series&#8239;II Limited Partner), are computed in order to comply with such regulation,
the Board of Directors may make such modification; <I>provided</I> that it is not likely to have a material effect on the amount distributable
to any Limited Partner pursuant to <U>Section&#8239;9.1</U> on the dissolution of the Partnership or the applicable Series. The Board
of Directors also shall (a)&#8239;make any adjustments that are necessary or appropriate to maintain equality between the Capital Accounts
of the Series&#8239;II Limited Partners and the amount of Series&#8239;II capital reflected on the Partnership&rsquo;s or Series, as applicable,
balance sheet, as computed for book purposes, in accordance with Treasury Regulation Section&#8239;1.704-1(b)(iv)(g), and (b)&#8239;make
any appropriate modifications in the event unanticipated events might otherwise cause this Agreement not to comply with Treasury Regulation
Section&#8239;1.704-1(b).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;8.7<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Transfer
of Capital Accounts</B>. The original Capital Account established for each transferee Series&#8239;II Limited Partner shall be in the
same amount as the Capital Account of the Series&#8239;II Limited Partner (or portion thereof) to which such transferee Limited Partner
succeeds at the time of such transfer. The Capital Account of any Series&#8239;II Limited Partner whose interest in Series&#8239;II shall
be increased or decreased by means of the transfer of Shares shall have a corresponding adjustment to such Series&#8239;II Limited Partner&rsquo;s
Capital Account. Any reference in this Agreement to a Capital Contribution of or distribution to a Series&#8239;II Limited Partner that
has succeeded to Shares in Series&#8239;II of any other Series&#8239;II Limited Partner shall include any Capital Contributions or distributions
previously made by or to the former Series&#8239;II Limited Partner on account of such Shares in Series&#8239;II.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 42; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="text-align: center; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->37<!-- Field: /Sequence --></FONT></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&#8239;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;8.8<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Credit
Facility Matters; Limited Partner Acknowledgments. </B>Each Limited Partner understands, acknowledges and agrees, in connection with
any Subscription-Backed Facility (and any security interest granted by the General Partner, the Operating Manager, or the Partnership),
that (unless otherwise instructed by the Subscription Line Lender on behalf of the General Partner or the Operating Manager under such
Subscription-Backed Facility) it shall pay all Capital Contributions into an account of the Partnership or any alternative investment
vehicle that will be pledged either directly or indirectly to a Subscription Line Lender (or to an agent for the benefit of a group of
Subscription Line Lenders) by the Partnership as collateral to directly or indirectly secure such Subscription-Backed Facility (the &ldquo;<B>Collateral
Account</B>&rdquo;) and that (i)&#8239;the Partnership or such Subscription Line Lender (or an agent for the benefit of a group of Subscription
Line Lenders) may from time to time request the delivery, within ninety (90) days after the end of such Limited Partner&rsquo;s fiscal
year, of (A)&#8239;a copy of such Limited Partner&rsquo;s annual report, if available, and/or (B)&#8239;such Limited Partner&rsquo;s balance
sheet as of the end of such fiscal year and the related statements of operations for such fiscal year prepared or reviewed by independent
public accountants in connection with such Limited Partner&rsquo;s annual reporting requirements, (ii)&#8239;the Partnership or such Subscription
Line Lender (or an agent for the benefit of a group of Subscription Line Lenders) may from time to time request a certificate confirming
the remaining amount of such Limited Partner&rsquo;s unfunded capital commitment, (iii)&#8239;such Limited Partner shall remain absolutely
and unconditionally obligated to fund its unfunded capital commitment called by the General Partner, the Operating Manager, or by the
Subscription Line Lenders (including those required as a result of the failure of any other Limited Partner to advance funds with respect
to a payment notice) without defense, counterclaim or offset of any kind (including any defense under Section&#8239;365 of the U.S. Bankruptcy
Code), (iv)&#8239;this Agreement is not an executory contract within the meaning of Section&#8239;365 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code, (v)&#8239;the
commitment by such Limited Partner to make Capital Contributions under this Agreement or otherwise is not a contract to make a loan,
or extend other debt financing or financial accommodations, to or for the benefit of the Partnership or to issue a security of the Partnership,
within the meaning of Section&#8239;365(c)(2)&#8239;of the Bankruptcy Code, (vi)&#8239;the Partnership has informed such Limited Partner
that for so long as such Subscription-Backed Facility is in place, the Partnership may, and such Limited Partner agrees that the Partnership
may, agree with such Subscription Line Lender (or an agent for the benefit of a group of Subscription Line Lenders) not to amend, modify,
supplement, cancel, terminate, reduce (other than with respect to funded capital commitments) or suspend any of such Limited Partner&rsquo;s
obligations hereunder or under its Subscription Agreement or to permit a Transfer or redemption without the prior written consent of
such Subscription Line Lender (or such agent for the benefit of a group of Subscription Line Lenders), (vii)&#8239;any payments made by
such Limited Partner hereunder and under its Subscription Agreement will not satisfy its obligation to fund its capital commitment unless
such contributions are paid into an account of the Partnership or any alternative investment vehicle, (viii)&#8239;any claims that such
Limited Partner may have against the Partnership, the General Partner, and/or the Operating Manager shall be subordinate to all payments
due to such Subscription Line Lender (or an agent for the benefit of a group of Subscription Line Lenders) under such Subscription-Backed
Facility, (ix)&#8239;such Limited Partner may be required, and such Limited Partner agrees, to make such other representations and deliver
such documents as the Partnership and/or such Subscription Line Lender (or an agent for the benefit of a group of Subscription Line Lenders)
may reasonably request, (x)&#8239;such Limited Partner shall use commercially reasonable efforts to provide to the Partnership and/or
to a Subscription Line Lender (or an agent for the benefit of a group of Subscription Line Lenders), if necessary, information and representations
necessary to enable the Partnership to determine whether the lending arrangement evidenced by the Subscription-Backed Facility will constitute
a non-exempt &ldquo;prohibited transaction&rdquo; under ERISA Section&#8239;406 or Code Section&#8239;4975, (xi)&#8239;such Limited Partner
is subject to commercial law with respect to its obligations under this Agreement and its Subscription Agreement, and that the making
and performance of this Agreement and such Limited Partner&rsquo;s Subscription Agreement constitute private and commercial acts rather
than governmental or public acts, and that neither such Limited Partner nor any of its properties or revenues has any right of immunity
from suit, court jurisdiction, execution of a judgment or from any other legal process with respect to its obligations under this Agreement
or such Limited Partner&rsquo;s Subscription Agreement, (xii)&#8239;to the extent that such Limited Partner may hereafter be entitled,
in any jurisdiction in which judicial proceedings may at any time be commenced, to claim any such immunity, and to the extent that in
any such jurisdiction there may be attributed to such Limited Partner such an immunity (whether or not claimed), such Limited Partner
hereby irrevocably agrees not to claim and hereby irrevocably waives such immunity to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law,
(xiii)&#8239;the Partnership has informed such Limited Partner that for so long as such Subscription-Backed Facility is in place, the
Partnership may, and such Limited Partner agrees that the Partnership may, agree with a Subscription Line Lender (or an agent for the
benefit of a group of Subscription Line Lenders) to (x)&#8239;grant to such Subscription Line Lender or agent certain consent rights with
respect to the Transfer of such Limited Partner&rsquo;s interest in the Partnership and (y)&#8239;make any such Transfer subject to satisfaction
of such consent rights and/or certain other conditions specified pursuant to the terms of a Subscription-Backed Facility, including funding
Capital Contributions required to reduce the outstanding amounts under such Subscription-Backed Facility resulting from such Transfer,
(xiv)&#8239;such Limited Partner&rsquo;s Subscription Agreement and this Agreement constitute such Limited Partner&rsquo;s legal, valid
and binding obligation, enforceable against such Limited Partner in accordance with their terms, subject to applicable bankruptcy, insolvency,
reorganization, moratorium, or other laws affecting creditors&rsquo; rights generally and to general principles of equity; and (xv)&#8239;that
to such Limited Partner&rsquo;s knowledge, as of the date hereof, there is no default under such Limited Partner&rsquo;s Subscription
Agreement or this Agreement, or claim or defense against any third-party lender or Affiliate thereof or other circumstances that, with
the passage of time and/or notice, would constitute a default under such Limited Partner&rsquo;s Subscription Agreement or this Agreement,
constitute a defense to, or right of offset against, such Limited Partner&rsquo;s obligation to fund its capital commitment or otherwise
reduce its capital commitment. Each Limited Partner further agrees to deliver, upon the request of the Partnership or a Subscription
Line Lender (or an agent for the benefit of a group of Subscription Line Lenders), in form and substance as the Partnership or such Subscription
Line Lender (or an agent for the benefit of a group of Subscription Line Lenders) may reasonably request (w)&#8239;an acknowledgment letter
incorporating the foregoing affirmations and agreements, along with other standard provisions a Subscription Line Lender (or an agent
for the benefit of a group of Subscription Line Lenders) may require, including an acknowledgment of such Limited Partner&rsquo;s equity
interest in the Partnership, (x)&#8239;appropriate estoppel certificates and parent entity guarantees (to the extent required by the Subscription
Line Lender(s)), (y)&#8239;an opinion of counsel to the effect that (i)&#8239;such Limited Partner&rsquo;s Subscription Agreement and such
Limited Partner&rsquo;s capital commitment set forth therein and (ii)&#8239;this Agreement and the obligations of such Limited Partner
arising hereunder, in each case is legal, valid and binding on such Limited Partner (<U>provided</U>, in the case of a Benefit Plan Investor,
counsel shall be permitted to assume, for purposes of the opinion, that the assets of the Partnership do not constitute assets of a Plan
of such Benefit Plan Investor) and (z)&#8239;such other instruments or to take such other action as the General Partner, the Operating
Manager, or such Subscription Line Lender (or agent for the benefit of a group of Subscription Line Lenders) may reasonably require to
effect any such borrowings by the Partnership or any of its Subsidiaries. For the avoidance of doubt, all Capital Contributions made
by any Limited Partner in accordance with this Agreement for the benefit of the Partnership&rsquo;s Credit Facility lenders (including
any Subscription Line Lender (or agent for the benefit of a group of Subscription Line Lenders)) shall constitute Capital Contributions
by such Limited Partner for purposes of this Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>
