    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="text-align: center; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->38<!-- Field: /Sequence --></FONT></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&#8239;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;8.9<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Default
of Limited Partner under Subscription Agreement.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(a)&#8239;Each Limited Partner
understands, acknowledges and agrees that, if so prescribed by the Limited Partner&rsquo;s Subscription Agreement, it is bound by the
capital commitment under such Limited Partner&rsquo;s Subscription Agreement and the Partnership may call capital from the Limited Partner
at one or more future closings, in the Partnership&rsquo;s discretion, based on unfunded subscriptions for any reason, provided that
no individual Limited Partner&rsquo;s aggregate subscription shall exceed its Investment Amount (as defined in the Limited Partner&rsquo;s
Subscription Agreement). Each Limited Partner that does not make a &ldquo;capital contribution&rdquo; (as defined in the Limited Partner&rsquo;s
Subscription Agreement) within ten (10)&#8239;Business Days following the date the Partnership provides capital call notice to the Limited
Partner (unless waived by the Partnership, in its sole discretion) (the &ldquo;<B>Defaulting Limited Partner</B>&rdquo;) shall pay interest
on such capital contribution from the date due until contributed or reimbursed to the Partnership at a rate equal to the lesser of (x)&#8239;10%
per annum and (y)&#8239;the maximum interest that may be charged by the Partnership on such amounts under applicable usury or other law
(&ldquo;<B>Default Interest</B>&rdquo;). Any distributions which a Defaulting Limited Partner would otherwise receive during any period
in which such Limited Partner is a Defaulting Limited Partner shall be applied by the Partnership against such Defaulting Limited Partner&rsquo;s
required capital contribution.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(b)&#8239;The Partnership
may cover Defaulting Limited Partner&rsquo;s unpaid capital contribution in any manner it deems appropriate, including but not limited
to increasing the capital contribution of Non-Defaulting Limited Partners pro rata, provided that individual Limited Partner&rsquo;s
aggregate subscription in the Partnership shall not exceed the Investment Amount.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(c)&#8239;Upon the Limited
Partner becoming the Defaulting Limited Partner, the Partnership may in its absolute discretion in addition to acting pursuant to <U>Section&#8239;8.9(a)</U>&#8239;or
Section&#8239;8.9(b)&#8239;take any one or more of the following actions:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(i)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>require
the Defaulting Limited Partner to submit its Shares for redemption in the next available Redemption Window, pursuant to <U>Section&#8239;7.9</U>
and reduce or terminate the remainder of the Defaulting Limited Partner&rsquo;s Investment Amount;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(ii)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>commence
legal proceedings against the Defaulting Limited Partner to collect the due and unpaid capital contribution plus Default Interest; and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(iii)&#8239; &#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;exercise
any other remedy available under applicable law that the General Partner determines to be in the best interests of the Partnership.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(d)&#8239;Except as may be
waived by the Partnership, each Limited Partner hereby pledges and assigns its Investment Amount in the Partnership to the Partnership
as security for the performance of the Partnership&rsquo;s obligation under any Subscription-Backed Facility and does hereby grant to
the Partnership all rights available to a secured party under the applicable laws.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>ARTICLE&#8239;IX</B></FONT><B><BR>
DISTRIBUTIONS; ALLOCATIONS OF SERIES II PROFITS AND SERIES II LOSSES</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;9.1<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Generally</B>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(a)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Subject
to the provisions of Sections 17-607, 17-218, 17-221 and 17-804 of the Act, the Board of Directors shall have sole discretion regarding
the amounts and timing of distributions to Limited Partners, in each case subject to the retention of, or payment to third parties of,
such funds or reserves as the Board of Directors deems necessary with respect to anticipated business needs of the Partnership and the
Series&#8239;which shall include (but not by way of limitation) the payment or the making of provision for the payment when due of obligations
of the Partnership generally or of the Series, including the payment of any management or administrative fees and expenses or any other
obligations.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 44; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="text-align: center; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->39<!-- Field: /Sequence --></FONT></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&#8239;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(b)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Distributions
made with respect to the Partnership generally and/or a Series&#8239;may exceed earnings and adjusted cash flow from operating activities
of the Partnership generally and/or the applicable Series&#8239;and may be paid from borrowings, offering proceeds and other sources.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(c)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Subject
to the rights of any holders of Shares specified in any Class&#8239;Designation and the terms of any Class&#8239;of Shares specified herein
or in any Class&#8239;Designation, distributions of cash shall be paid to the holders of record of such Shares as of the applicable record
date established by the Board of Directors <I>pro rata</I> in proportion to their respective Percentage Interests on such record date.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(d)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Cash
distributions to holders of Shares pursuant to <U>Section&#8239;9.1(c)</U>&#8239;are subject to the terms of the DRIP and such cash distributions
will automatically be reinvested under the DRIP in additional whole and fractional Shares unless such holders have elected in their Subscription
Agreement or otherwise provided notice to the Partnership using the appropriate documentation and the applicable Series&#8239;of such
election to receive distributions in cash. Limited Partners may terminate their participation in the DRIP with prior written notice to
the Partnership and the applicable Series. Under the DRIP, distributions in respect of Shares are reinvested in Shares of the same Class&#8239;for
a purchase price equal to the most recently available NAV per Share as of the end of the prior month.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(e)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
DRIP in effect as of the date hereof is attached as <U>Schedule B</U> to this Agreement. The Board of Directors may, without the consent
of any Person, amend, modify, revise or restate the DRIP from time to time and any such amendment, modification, revision or restatement
of the DRIP shall not constitute an amendment to this Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(f)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Notwithstanding
anything to the contrary contained in this Agreement, (i)&#8239;no distribution shall be made to a Partner if and to the extent that such
distribution would violate the Act or other applicable law and (ii)&#8239;no distribution shall be required or permitted to be made or
have priority if such distribution would violate the terms of any, to the extent applicable, agreement, guarantee, transfer or pledge
or any other instrument to which the Partnership is a party (including any Credit Facility or other indebtedness), and any rights to
distribution hereunder shall be subordinate to the Partnership&rsquo;s obligations under any such agreement or instrument.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;9.2<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Allocation
of Series&#8239;II Profit and Series&#8239;II Loss</B>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(a)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>All
special allocations pursuant to <U>Section&#8239;9.3</U> with respect to such fiscal year, all Series&#8239;II Profits and Series&#8239;II
Losses (including special allocations of distribution fees and other than Series&#8239;II Profits and Series&#8239;II Losses specially
allocated pursuant to <U>Section&#8239;9.3</U>) shall be allocated to the Series&#8239;II Limited Partners&rsquo; Capital Accounts in a
manner such that, as of the end of such fiscal year, the Capital Account of each Series&#8239;II Limited Partner (which may be either
a positive or negative balance) shall be equal to the amount which would be distributed to such Series&#8239;II Limited Partner if Series&#8239;II
were to liquidate all of its assets for the Book Value thereof and distributed the proceeds thereof pursuant to the order of priorities
set forth herein, minus such Series&#8239;II Limited Partner&rsquo;s share of Series&#8239;II Minimum Gain and Series&#8239;II Limited Partner
Nonrecourse Debt Minimum Gain, computed immediately prior to the hypothetical liquidation of assets of Series&#8239;II.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 45; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="text-align: center; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->40<!-- Field: /Sequence --></FONT></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&#8239;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(b)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>All
Series&#8239;II Profits and Series&#8239;II Losses allocable to any Series&#8239;II Limited Partner shall be allocated on a monthly basis
based upon the results of Series&#8239;II&rsquo;s operations during such month, without regard to whether cash distributions were made
to the Series&#8239;II Limited Partner during such calendar month; however, such allocation shall be made in accordance with a method
permissible under Code Section&#8239;704(c)&#8239;and the Treasury Regulations thereunder.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(c)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Partnership, and each Series, shall separately track and reflect on its books and records Operating Expenses allocable to a single Class&#8239;(including,
for the avoidance of doubt, Management Fees), as determined by the Board of Directors in good faith, and allocate such Operating Expenses
to such Class.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;9.3<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Special
Allocations</B>. Notwithstanding the provisions of <U>Section&#8239;9.2</U>:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(a)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Series&#8239;II
Nonrecourse Deductions shall be allocated to the Series&#8239;II Limited Partners, <I>pro rata</I> in proportion to the value of their
respective interests in Series&#8239;II, as determined by the Board of Directors. If there is a net decrease in Series&#8239;II Minimum
Gain during any Taxable Year, each Series&#8239;II Limited Partner shall be specially allocated items of taxable income or gain for such
Taxable Year (and, if necessary, subsequent Taxable Years) in an amount equal to such Series&#8239;II Limited Partner&rsquo;s share of
the net decrease in Series&#8239;II Minimum Gain, determined in accordance with Treasury Regulation Section&#8239;1.704-2(g)&#8239;(subject
to the exceptions thereunder). The items to be so allocated shall be determined in accordance with Treasury Regulation Section&#8239;1.704-2(f)(6).
This paragraph is intended to comply with the minimum gain chargeback requirements in Treasury Regulation Section&#8239;1.704-2(f)&#8239;and
shall be interpreted consistently therewith.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(b)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Series&#8239;II
Limited Partner Nonrecourse Deductions shall be allocated in the manner required by Treasury Regulation Section&#8239;1.704-2(i). Except
as otherwise provided in Treasury Regulation Section&#8239;1.704-2(i)(4), if there is a net decrease in Series&#8239;II Limited Partner
Nonrecourse Debt Minimum Gain during any Taxable Year, each Series&#8239;II Limited Partner that has a share of such Series&#8239;II Limited
Partner Nonrecourse Debt Minimum Gain shall be specially allocated items of taxable income or gain for such Taxable Year (and, if necessary,
subsequent Taxable Years) in an amount equal to that Series&#8239;II Limited Partner&rsquo;s share of the net decrease in Series&#8239;II
Limited Partner Nonrecourse Debt Minimum Gain (subject to the exceptions thereunder). Items to be allocated pursuant to this paragraph
shall be determined in accordance with Treasury Regulation Sections 1.704-2(i)(4)&#8239;and 1.704-2(j)(2). This paragraph is intended
to comply with the minimum gain chargeback requirements in Treasury Regulation Section&#8239;1.704-2(i)(4)&#8239;and shall be interpreted
consistently therewith.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 46; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="text-align: center; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->41<!-- Field: /Sequence --></FONT></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&#8239;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(c)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>If
any Series&#8239;II Limited Partner unexpectedly receives any adjustments, allocations or distributions described in Treasury Regulation
Section&#8239;1.704-1(b)(2)(ii)(d)(4), (5)&#8239;or (6), items of taxable income and gain shall be specially allocated to such Series&#8239;II
Limited Partner in an amount and manner sufficient to eliminate the adjusted capital account deficit (determined according to Treasury
Regulation Section&#8239;1.704-1(b)(2)(ii)(d)) created by such adjustments, allocations or distributions as quickly as possible. This
paragraph is intended to comply with the qualified income offset requirements in Treasury Regulation Section&#8239;1.704-1(b)(2)(ii)(d)&#8239;and
shall be interpreted consistently therewith.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(d)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>No
allocation of Series&#8239;II Loss shall be made pursuant to <U>Section&#8239;9.2</U> to the extent that it causes or increases a deficit
balance in any Series&#8239;II Limited Partner&rsquo;s Adjusted Capital Account. To the extent any allocation of Series&#8239;II Loss would
cause the Adjusted Capital Account balance of any of the Series&#8239;II Limited Partners to have a deficit balance, such Series&#8239;II
Loss shall be allocated to the Series&#8239;II Limited Partners with positive balances in their Adjusted Capital Accounts in proportion
with such relative positive Adjusted Capital Account balances.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(e)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
allocations set forth in paragraphs (a), (b), (c)&#8239;and (d)&#8239;above (the &ldquo;<B>Regulatory Allocations</B>&rdquo;) are intended
to comply with certain requirements of the Treasury Regulations under Code Section&#8239;704.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">Notwithstanding any other
provisions of this <U>Section&#8239;9.3</U> (other than the Regulatory Allocations), the Regulatory Allocations shall be taken into account
in allocating Series&#8239;II Profits and Series&#8239;II Losses among Series&#8239;II Limited Partners so that, to the extent possible,
the net amount of such allocations of Series&#8239;II Profits and Series&#8239;II Losses and other items and the Regulatory Allocations
(including Regulatory Allocations that, although not yet made, are expected to be made in the future) to each Series&#8239;II Limited
Partner shall be equal to the net amount that would have been allocated to such Series&#8239;II Limited Partner if the Regulatory Allocations
had not occurred.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;9.4<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Amounts
Withheld</B>. All amounts withheld pursuant to <U>Section&#8239;9.8</U> from any distribution to a Limited Partner shall be treated as
amounts distributed to such Limited Partner pursuant to <U>Section&#8239;9.1</U> for all purposes under this Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;9.5<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Tax
Allocations: Code Section&#8239;704(c</B>).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(i)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
income, gains, losses, deductions and expenses of Series&#8239;II shall be allocated, for U.S. federal, state and local income tax purposes,
among the Series&#8239;II Limited Partners in accordance with the allocation of such income, gains, losses, deductions and expenses among
the Series&#8239;II Limited Partners for computing their Capital Accounts, except that if any such allocation is not permitted by the
Code or other applicable law, Series&#8239;II&rsquo;s subsequent income, gains, losses, deductions and expenses shall be allocated among
the Series&#8239;II Limited Partners so as to reflect as nearly as possible the allocations set forth herein in computing their Capital
Accounts. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Board of Directors in its sole discretion shall make such allocations for tax purposes as
may be needed to ensure that allocations are in accordance with the interests of the Limited Partners and in a manner intended to give
economic effect to the provisions of this Agreement, within the meaning of the Code and Treasury Regulations. The Board of Directors
shall determine all matters concerning allocations for U.S. federal, state, local or non-U.S. tax purposes not expressly provided for
herein in its sole discretion. In the event a Limited Partner&rsquo;s Shares are redeemed pursuant to <U>Section&#8239;7.9</U> or <U>Section&#8239;10.10</U>,
the Board of Directors may specially allocate additional items of ordinary income or loss or capital gain (including short-term capital
gain) or loss to such Limited Partner insofar as is possible to reduce the difference, if any, between the aggregate amounts allocated
to such Limited Partner&rsquo;s Capital Account and the aggregate amount of tax items allocated to such Limited Partner. For purposes
of the foregoing, the Board of Directors may determine that an equitable method of allocation includes, without limitation, an allocation
(i)&#8239;pro rata based on the relative differences between amounts allocated to the Capital Accounts and the aggregate amounts of tax
items allocated to the relevant Limited Partners, or (ii)&#8239;solely to the relevant Limited Partners with the greatest such differences
(taking into account such allocations).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="text-align: center; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->42<!-- Field: /Sequence --></FONT></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&#8239;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(ii)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>In
accordance with Code Section&#8239;704(c)&#8239;and the Treasury Regulations thereunder, income, gain, loss, deduction and expense with
respect to any property contributed to the capital of Series&#8239;II shall, solely for tax purposes, be allocated among the Series&#8239;II
Limited Partners so as to take account of any variation between the adjusted basis of such property to Series&#8239;II for U.S. federal
income tax purposes and its fair market value at the time of contribution using any reasonable method provided for in the Treasury Regulations
as selected by the Board of Directors in its sole discretion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(iii)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>If
the Book Value of any Series&#8239;II asset is adjusted pursuant to <U>Section&#8239;8.5</U>, subsequent allocations of items of taxable
income, gain, loss, deduction and expense with respect to such asset shall take account of any variation between the adjusted basis of
such asset for U.S. federal income tax purposes and its Book Value in the same manner as under Code Section&#8239;704(c). Any elections
or other decisions relating to such allocations shall be made by the Board of Directors in any manner that reasonably reflects the purpose
and intent of this Agreement. Allocations pursuant to this <U>Section&#8239;9.5</U> are solely for purposes of U.S. federal, state and
local taxes and shall not affect, or in any way be taken into account in computing, any Series&#8239;II Limited Partner&rsquo;s Capital
Account or share of Series&#8239;II Profits, Series&#8239;II Losses, other items or distributions pursuant to any provisions of this Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;9.6<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Tax
Elections</B>. Except as otherwise provided herein, the Board of Directors shall, in its sole discretion, determine whether to make any
available election pursuant to the Code. The Board of Directors shall have the right to seek to revoke any such election, including any
election related to the matters described in <U>Section&#8239;3.2</U> upon the Board of Directors&rsquo; determination in its sole discretion
that such revocation is in the best interests of the Limited Partners.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;9.7<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Tax
Matters</B>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(a)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Board of Directors may designate a &ldquo;partnership representative&rdquo; (the &ldquo;<B>Partnership Representative</B>&rdquo;) as
defined in Section&#8239;6223 of the Code with respect to operations conducted by Series&#8239;II pursuant to this Agreement. The Partnership
Representative is authorized and required to represent Series&#8239;II (at the expense of Series&#8239;II) in connection with all examinations
of the affairs of Series&#8239;II by any U.S. federal, state or local tax authorities, including any resulting administrative and judicial
proceedings, and to expend funds of Series&#8239;II for professional services and costs associated therewith and may act as or appoint
an individual to act as a &ldquo;designated individual&rdquo; on behalf, and subject to the direction and control, of the Partnership
Representative in accordance with Treasury Regulations Section&#8239;301.6223-1. The Partnership Representative shall be authorized to
take any actions necessary under the Code (or any similar state, local or non-U.S. law) that it deems appropriate in its sole discretion,
including making an election under Section&#8239;6226(a)&#8239;of the Code with respect to any imputed underpayment. This <U>Section&#8239;9.7</U>
shall survive the dissolution, winding-up and termination of the Partnership or Series&#8239;II, and each Limited Partner&rsquo;s obligations
pursuant to this <U>Section&#8239;9.7</U> shall survive such Limited Partner&rsquo;s ceasing to be a Series&#8239;II Limited Partner.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="text-align: center; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->43<!-- Field: /Sequence --></FONT></P></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(b)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Board of Directors shall use its best efforts to ensure that Series&#8239;II satisfies the gross income requirements of Section&#8239;7704(c)(2)&#8239;of
the Code for each Taxable Year of Series&#8239;II.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;9.8<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Withholding</B>.
Each Limited Partner hereby indemnifies the Partnership generally and each Series&#8239;for and authorizes the Partnership and each Series&#8239;to
withhold from or pay on behalf of or with respect to such Limited Partner any amount of U.S. federal, state, local or foreign taxes that
the Board of Directors determines, in its sole discretion, that the Partnership generally or the Series&#8239;is required to withhold
or pay with respect to any amount distributable to such Limited Partner pursuant to this Agreement, including any taxes required to be
withheld or paid by the Partnership or the Series&#8239;pursuant to Sections 1441, 1442, 1445, 1446, 1471, 1472 or 6226 of the Code. This
<U>Section&#8239;9.8</U> shall survive the dissolution, winding-up and termination of the Partnership and each Series, and each Limited
Partner&rsquo;s obligations pursuant to this <U>Section&#8239;9.8</U> shall survive such Limited Partner&rsquo;s ceasing to be a holder
of Shares.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>ARTICLE&#8239;X<BR>
RESTRICTION ON TRANSFER AND OWNERSHIP OF SHARES</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;10.1<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Cessation
of a Limited Partner</B>. A Limited Partner shall cease to be a Limited Partner of the Partnership generally or as a partner of the Partnership
associated with a Series&#8239;(i)&#8239;by having all of such Limited Partner&rsquo;s Shares (or its Shares in such Series, as applicable)
redeemed pursuant to the Share Redemption Program or (ii)&#8239;in connection with the assignment of all of its Shares (or its Shares
in such Series, as applicable) and the admission of a Substitute Limited Partner in accordance with this Agreement, and otherwise may
not withdraw as a Limited Partner. The cessation of a Limited Partner as a Limited Partner, in and of itself, shall not dissolve or terminate
the Partnership or any Series. Notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement, the Bankruptcy of a Limited Partner shall not cause
such Limited Partner to cease to be a limited partner of the Partnership generally or to be a limited partner of the Partnership associated
with a Series, and upon the occurrence of such an event, the Partnership and each Series&#8239;shall continue without dissolution. Upon
the occurrence of any event that causes the last remaining limited partner of the Partnership to cease to be a limited partner of the
Partnership, to the fullest extent permitted by law, the personal representative of such limited partner is hereby authorized to, and
shall, within ninety (90) days after the occurrence of the event that terminated the continued membership of such limited partner in
the Partnership, agree in writing (i)&#8239;to continue the Partnership and each Series&#8239;and (ii)&#8239;to the admission of the personal
representative or its nominee or designee, as the case may be, as a substitute limited partner of the Partnership generally and as a
limited partner of the Partnership associated with each Series, effective as of the occurrence of the event that terminated the continued
membership of such limited partner of the Partnership in the Partnership. In the event that a Limited Partner experiences death, legal
incompetence or other termination, the estate, legal representative or successor of such Limited Partner shall be deemed to be the Assignee
of the Shares of such Limited Partner.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;10.2<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Tender
Offers</B>. If any Person other than a Series&#8239;or the Partnership generally makes a tender offer, including a &ldquo;mini-tender&rdquo;
offer, for Shares of the Partnership, such Person must comply with all of the provisions set forth in Regulation 14D of the Exchange
Act, including disclosure and notice requirements, that would be applicable if the tender offer was for more than 5% of the outstanding
Shares; <I>provided</I>, <I>however</I>, that such documents are not required to be filed with the SEC. In addition, any such Person
must provide notice to the Partnership and the applicable Series&#8239;at least ten (10)&#8239;Business Days prior to initiating any such
tender offer. Any Person who initiates a tender offer without complying with the provisions set forth above (a &ldquo;<B>Non-Compliant
Tender Offer</B>&rdquo;), shall be responsible for all expenses incurred by the Partnership generally and the applicable Series&#8239;in
connection with the enforcement of the provisions of this <U>Section&#8239;10.2</U>, including expenses incurred in connection with the
review of all documents related to such tender offer. In addition, the Partnership generally and/or any Series&#8239;may seek injunctive
relief, including a temporary or permanent restraining order, in connection with any Non-Compliant Tender Offer. This <U>Section&#8239;10.2</U>
shall be of no force or effect with respect to any Shares that are then listed on a national securities exchange.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;10.3<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Assignment</B>.(a)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Subject
to the provisions of <U>Sections 10.3(b)</U>&#8239;and <U>(c)</U>, <U>10.4</U>, <U>10.5</U> and <U>10.6</U> of this Agreement, any Limited
Partner may Assign all or some of the Shares owned by such Limited Partner to any Person (the &ldquo;<B>Assignee</B>&rdquo;) in whole
or in part; <I>provided</I> that:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(i)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>such
Limited Partner and such Assignee shall each execute a written Assignment instrument, which shall:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 2in">(A)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>set
forth the terms of such Assignment;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 2in">(B)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>evidence
the acceptance by the Assignee to be bound by all of the terms and provisions of this Agreement, the applicable Series&#8239;Agreement
(if any) and any applicable Class&#8239;Designation;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 2in">(C)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>include
a representation by both such Limited Partner and such Assignee that such Assignment was made in accordance with all applicable laws
and regulations (including such minimum investment and investor suitability requirements as may then be applicable under state securities
laws); and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 2in">(D)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>otherwise
be satisfactory in form and substance to the Board of Directors.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(b)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Notwithstanding
the foregoing, unless the Board of Directors shall specifically consent, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, no Shares
may be Assigned:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(i)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>to
a minor or incompetent (unless a guardian, custodian or conservator has been appointed to handle the affairs of such Person);</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 50; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="text-align: center; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->45<!-- Field: /Sequence --></FONT></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&#8239;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(ii)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>to
any Person if, in the opinion of counsel, such Assignment would result in the termination of the Partnership or a Series&#8239;for U.S.
federal income tax purposes; <I>provided</I>, <I>however</I>, that the Board of Directors may permit such Assignment to become effective
if and when, in the opinion of counsel, such Assignment would no longer result in the termination of the Partnership or the Series, as
applicable, for U.S. federal income tax purposes;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(iii)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>to
any Person if such Assignment would affect the Partnership&rsquo;s existence or qualification as a limited partnership under the Act
or the applicable laws of any other jurisdiction in which the Partnership is then conducting business;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(iv)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>to
any Person not permitted to be an Assignee under applicable law, including applicable U.S. federal and state securities laws;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(v)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>if
such Assignment would result in the transfer of less than 1 Share (unless such Assignment is of all of the Shares owned by such Limited
Partner);</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(vi)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>if
such Assignment would result in the retention by such Limited Partner of less than 1 Share; or</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(vii)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>if,
in the reasonable belief of the Board of Directors, such Assignment might violate applicable law.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Notwithstanding the foregoing, no Shares may be Assigned if, in the
determination of the Board of Directors, such Assignment would not be in the best interests of the Partnership generally or a Series.
To the fullest extent permitted by law, any attempt to make any Assignment of Shares in violation of this <U>(b)</U>&#8239;shall be null
and void <I>ab initio</I>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(c)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Assignments
made in accordance with this <U>Section&#8239;10.3</U> shall be considered consummated upon satisfaction or waiver of all of the conditions
of this <U>Section&#8239;10.3</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;10.4<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Substitution</B>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(a)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Only
an Assignee to which a Limited Partner has assigned its Shares may be admitted to the Partnership as a limited partner of the Partnership
generally or associated with a particular Series, as a Substitute Limited Partner. Such an Assignee may be admitted to the Partnership
generally or associated with a particular Series&#8239;as a Substitute Limited Partner upon the applicable Assignment being considered
consummated pursuant to <U>Section&#8239;10.3(c)</U>&#8239;and the satisfaction of the following conditions:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(i)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>the
Board of Directors or its delegate has reasonably determined that all conditions specified in <U>Section&#8239;10.3</U> have been satisfied
and that no adverse effect to the Partnership generally or a Series&#8239;does or may result from such admission; and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(ii)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>such
Assignee shall have executed a transfer agreement and such other forms as the Board of Directors reasonably may require to determine
compliance with this <U>Article&#8239;X</U>, and shall be deemed to have authorized and appointed with full power of substitution as its,
his or her true and lawful agent and attorney-in-fact, with full power and authority in its, his or her name, place and stead, the Operating
Manager, the Partnership, the applicable Series&#8239;and each of their authorized officers and attorneys-in-fact, as the case may be,
to take such actions as set forth in <U>Section&#8239;3.3</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 51; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="text-align: center; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->46<!-- Field: /Sequence --></FONT></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&#8239;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(b)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>An
Assignee who does not become a Substitute Limited Partner in accordance with this <U>Section&#8239;10.4</U> and who desires to make a
further Assignment of its, his or her Shares shall be subject to all the provisions of <U>Article&#8239;X</U> to the same extent and in
the same manner as a Limited Partner desiring to make an Assignment of Shares. Failure or refusal of the Board of Directors to admit
an Assignee as a Substitute Limited Partner shall in no way affect the right of such Assignee to receive distributions and the share
of the Series&#8239;II Profits or Series&#8239;II Losses for tax purposes to which its, his or her predecessor in interest would have been
entitled in accordance with this Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;10.5<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Status
of an Assigning Limited Partner</B>. Any Limited Partner that shall Assign all of its, his or her Shares shall be deemed to have withdrawn
from the Partnership generally and the applicable Series&#8239;as a Limited Partner, cease to be a Limited Partner and shall no longer
have any of the rights or privileges of a Limited Partner.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;10.6<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Further
Restrictions on Transfers</B>. Notwithstanding any provision to the contrary contained herein, the following restrictions shall also
apply to any and all proposed sales, Assignments and Transfers of Shares, and any proposed sale, Assignment or Transfer in violation
of same shall be, to the fullest extent permitted by law, void <I>ab initio</I>, unless otherwise waived by the Board of Directors.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(a)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>No
Limited Partner shall make any Transfer or Assignment of all or any part of its, his or her Shares if said Transfer or Assignment, when
considered with all other Transfers during the same applicable 12 month period, would, in the opinion of the Board of Directors, result
in the termination of Series&#8239;II&rsquo;s status as a partnership, or cause Series&#8239;II to be treated as a &ldquo;publicly traded
partnership&rdquo; taxable as a corporation, for U.S. federal or state income tax purposes.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(b)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>No
Limited Partner shall make any Transfer or Assignment of all or any of its, his or her Shares unless the transferee would have been qualified
to purchase Shares in the offering of Shares and no transferee may acquire or hold less than the minimum initial purchase amount of $10,000
for Investor Shares, which amount can be modified or waived in the sole discretion of the Partnership or the Operating Manager, unless
such Transfer is made on behalf of a retirement plan, or such Transfer is made by gift, inheritance, intra-family transfer, family dissolution,
or to Affiliates.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(c)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Each
Limited Partner that is a legal entity (other than a Benefit Plan Investor) acknowledges that its management shall have a fiduciary responsibility
for the safekeeping and use of all funds and assets of any assignee to all or a portion of its interest as a Limited Partner, and that
the management of each Limited Partner that is a legal entity (other than a Benefit Plan Investor) shall not employ, or permit another
to employ such funds or assets that are attributable to any assignee of all or a portion of such Limited Partner&rsquo;s interest as
a Limited Partner in any manner except for the exclusive benefit of the assignee. Each Limited Partner, other than a Benefit Plan Investor,
agrees that it will not contract away the foregoing fiduciary duty.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 52; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="text-align: center; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->47<!-- Field: /Sequence --></FONT></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&#8239;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(d)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>No
Limited Partner shall make any Transfer or Assignment of all or any part of its, his or her Shares if said Transfer or Assignment would
create a potential REIT qualification problem under the ownership requirements in Section&#8239;856(a)(5)&#8239;or 856(a)(6)&#8239;of the
Code or any other requirements of Sections 856 through 857 of the Code for any REIT Subsidiary.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;10.7<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Elimination
or Modification of Restrictions</B>. Notwithstanding any of the foregoing provisions of this <U>Article&#8239;X</U>, the Board of Directors
may amend this Agreement without the consent of any Person to eliminate or modify any restriction on substitution of Limited Partners
or the Transfer or Assignment of Shares at such time as the restriction is no longer necessary or advisable.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;10.8<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Records</B>.
The Board of Directors shall cause the Limited Partnership List to be updated to reflect changes in the Limited Partners admitted in
accordance with this Agreement, which updates shall not constitute an amendment to this Agreement or any Series&#8239;Agreement (if any).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;10.9<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>[Reserved]</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;10.10<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Compulsory
Redemptions.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(a)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Notwithstanding
anything in this Agreement but subject to the Act, the Board of Directors may cause the Partnership or a Series&#8239;to redeem from time
to time all or some of the Shares of a Limited Partner without the consent or action by such Limited Partner or any other Person, on
not less than five days&rsquo; prior written notice, if the Board of Directors determines that:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(i)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>the
Shares have been transferred in violation of this Agreement, or have vested in any Person by operation of law as a result of the disability,
death, divorce, dissolution, termination, bankruptcy, insolvency or adjudicated incompetence of the Limited Partner;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(ii)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>any
Limited Partner does not meet any investor eligibility requirements established by the Partnership or the applicable Series&#8239;from
time to time;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(iii)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>ownership
of Shares by a Limited Partner or other Person is likely to cause the Partnership generally or a Series&#8239;to be in violation of, or
require registration of the Shares under, or subject the Partnership generally or a Series&#8239;to additional registration or regulation
under, the securities, commodities, or other laws of the United States or any other relevant jurisdiction in the world, including without
limitation the Investment Company Act;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(iv)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>continued
ownership of the Shares by a Limited Partner may be harmful or injurious to the business or reputation of the Partnership generally,
a Series, the Operating Manager, Monroe or any of their Affiliates, or may subject the Partnership generally, a Series&#8239;or any Limited
Partner to an undue risk of adverse tax or other fiscal or regulatory consequences;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 53; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="text-align: center; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->48<!-- Field: /Sequence --></FONT></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&#8239;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(v)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>any
of the representations and warranties made by a Limited Partner or other Person in connection with the acquisition of Shares was not
true when made or has ceased to be true;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(vi)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>with
respect to a Limited Partner subject to special laws or regulations, the Limited Partner is likely to be subject to additional regulatory
or compliance requirements under these special laws or regulations by virtue of continuing to hold any Shares;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(vii)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>it
would be in the interest of the Partnership generally or a Series, as determined by the Board of Directors, for the Partnership or the
Series&#8239;to redeem the Shares;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(viii)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>continued
ownership of any Shares by a Limited Partner may cause all or any portion of the assets of the Partnership generally or a Series&#8239;to
be characterized as assets of a Plan for purposes of ERISA, Section&#8239;4975 of the Code or any Other Plan Law; or</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1.5in">(ix)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>any
Limited Partner fails to maintain a minimum balance of $500 of its Shares.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(b)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Shares
redeemed pursuant to <U>Section&#8239;10.10(a)</U>&#8239;will be redeemed at a price equal to the transaction price of the Class&#8239;of
Shares being redeemed on the date of such redemption, which will be equal to the Partnership&rsquo;s or the applicable Series&rsquo;
most recently published NAV per Share for the applicable Class&#8239;of Shares unless otherwise determined by the Board of Directors in
its sole discretion. Limited Partners whose Shares are redeemed by the Partnership generally or a Series&#8239;will not be entitled to
a return of any amount of sales load that was charged in connection with such Limited Partner&rsquo;s purchase of such Shares. If the
Partnership or a Series&#8239;requires the mandatory redemption of any Shares of any Limited Partner, such redemption will not be subject
to the redemption limits under the Share Redemption Program, including any redemption limitations set forth therein, unless otherwise
determined by the Board of Directors in its sole discretion; <I>provided</I> that, for the avoidance of doubt, such Limited Partner or
its assignee whose Shares are being mandatorily redeemed may, in the sole discretion of the Board of Directors, be subject to the Early
Redemption Deduction in accordance with the Share Redemption Program. A Limited Partner that shall have all of such Limited Partner&rsquo;s
Shares redeemed by the Partnership generally or a Series&#8239;shall cease to be a Limited Partner and shall no longer have any of the
rights or privileges of a Limited Partner hereunder, at law or in equity.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(c)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>From
time to time, the Board of Directors may, in its discretion and without the consent of any other Person, assign the right of the Partnership
generally and/or any Series&#8239;to redeem Shares pursuant to this <U>Section&#8239;10.10</U> to Monroe or its Affiliates.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>ARTICLE&#8239;XI<BR>
MEETINGS AND VOTING RIGHTS OF PARTNERS</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;11.1<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Partnership
Informational Meetings</B>. The General Partner may hold, from time to time, general informational meetings with the Limited Partners,
which may be telephonic.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Section&#8239;11.2<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Voting
Rights of Limited Partners</B>. Except as expressly set forth in this Agreement, any Series&#8239;Agreement (if any) or any Class&#8239;Designation,
the Limited Partners shall have no voting rights whatsoever with respect to the Partnership generally or any Series, including under
the Act.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>
